triples.evidence_text: In line with the flooding response actions identified in MGN 570 (F) Amendment No.1 the crew mustered; donned the appropriate lifejackets; started the available bilge pumps; contacted the coastguard (albeit without activating the DSC alert), and deployed the liferaft to abandon ship.

triples.tail_surface: stern seal was assumed to be the source
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 艉轴密封被假定为泄漏源
triples.evidence_text: The stern seal was assumed to be the source due to the vibration experienced and alternative sources were not considered.

triples.tail_surface: close the seawater inlets and discharges at an early stage of the emergency as a flood control measure
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在紧急早期关闭海水进口和排放口作为堵漏措施
triples.evidence_text: With the belief the water ingress was from the stern seal, the opportunity to close the seawater inlets and discharges at an early stage of the emergency as a flood control measure was not taken, although some were later shut.

triples.tail_surface: training on the operation of the portable salvage pump had identified that a replacement was needed based on its condition
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 通过便携式救助泵操作培训发现需更换
triples.evidence_text: Additionally, previous training on the operation of the portable salvage pump had identified that a replacement was needed based on its condition.

the skipper had previously taken measures to mitigate the flooding risk by modifying seawater valve operating positions, reducing the number of through-hull connections, and fitting bilge pumps and emergency bilge pumps that exceeded the requirement of MSN 1872 (F) Amendment 1.
